description: A colorful sticker-by-number picture of a snail is on the bed, with a sheet of peeled sticker pieces off to the right. The left hand stays on the picture to steady it as the right hand reaches to the sticker sheet, pinches up a small yellow sticker, moves left over the snail’s shell, and presses it down onto a matching spot, smoothing it into place while the left hand continues holding the page.
